observations.uncertainty: Vector computations only. OSM mapping accuracy unverified: use ±5m plan-position/outline allowance and ±2° face direction. Ring likely covers broad protection base/terrace, not upper tower diameter; no survey claim.
71m is rounded source statement, use ±1m; cover9.7m reported by designer. No as-built measurement; OSM height71.7 is unverified. Local ground/sea-level datum pending separately.

value.nearCardinalOctagonalFaces: east/north faces approximately cardinal, mapped edges .487°/269.385° bearing

observations.uncertainty: Mapped face bearings measured using city config; regular upper-profile22.8° is an approximation ±2°. South-front photo aligned to mapped south access; camera bearing ±15°, no EXIF.

observations.value: One modern octagonal five-storey pagoda; broad lower protection base and first roof, four upper galleries with waist eaves, major roofs reduce upward and gold finial; exactly five main storeys, not a five-sided/eight-storey tower.
observations.uncertainty: Designer text and actually viewed section/south-front/lake real photos establish limited exterior form. Layer heights/eave radii/ornament estimates recorded in spec, not as-built survey. Base edges/entrances hidden by trees; all-side survey pending.

observations.value: modern steel structure, copper exterior members; source-visible dark roof/columns, pale base/rails and gold-colored finial
observations.uncertainty: Source material description; shared PBR colors are a candidate approximation, no calibrated color sample or final finish/lighting acceptance.

observations.value: South axial access visible in designer front photo; OSM way/340652169 south access and east stairs way/1448327495 are retained as access evidence.
observations.uncertainty: Direction/relationship only; clearances, mechanical escalator state and traversable collision geometry pending; dark base inset is a visual marker only.

conflicts.resolution: Not adopted. Designer source explicitly octagonal and five-storey, corroborated by source photos/drawings and OSM building:levels=5.

levels.method: five rows [gallery floor, core circumradius, column circumradius, major eave height, roof inner/top height, eave circumradius]; ratios traced from THUPDI section and checked against south-front real photo, scaled by reported approx 71m; first floor uses reported cover 9.7m
levels.uncertainty: gallery/main-eave levels ±2m; core/column/eave radii ±15%; no measured floor plan or construction drawing

octagonVertexAngleDegrees.method: regular upper octagon aligned to mapped near-cardinal north/east base faces; vertex angle22.5° + estimated .3° face twist
octagonVertexAngleDegrees.uncertainty: ±2° from map-edge irregularity; applies to regular upper profiles, source base is preserved exactly

eaveCornerLiftM.method: small convex corner upsweep seen in south-front photo; ratio to approx71m

waistCornerLiftM.method: smaller gallery waist-eave upsweep in section/photo

finialBaseM.method: gold finial base relative to total section height and source south-front photo
finialBaseM.uncertainty: ±2m; ring counts/diameters are representative decorative expression

coverTopPlanFactor.method: limited slope representation of broad cover base, preserving real mapped outer ring at ground and terrace
coverTopPlanFactor.uncertainty: ±.06 factor; photos obscure sides; not a structural/survey reconstruction

decorativeMembers.method: bounded representative rhythm from front photo and section; no independently confirmed schedule
decorativeMembers.uncertainty: widths ±40%; bay count and bracket shapes are abstraction, not quantity survey
